title: Privacy Policy
intro: At Simphonia ("we", "us", "our"), we are committed to protecting your privacy in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the Portuguese Data Protection Law, and other applicable data protection legislation. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our mobile application and website (collectively, the "Service").

content.text: 1.1 Account Information
When you create an account or make a purchase, we collect:

items: Full name and email address
Password (stored in securely hashed form — we never store or have access to your plain-text password)
Profile photo (if provided via social login)
Account preferences: language, currency, and theme settings

content.text: 1.2 Social Login Data
If you sign in or register using a third-party provider (Google, Facebook, or Apple), we receive the following information from that provider:

items: Name and email address associated with your social account
Profile photo URL
A unique provider identifier to link your social account

content.text: We do not receive or store your social media passwords. Authentication tokens from social providers are used only during the login process and for identity verification.
1.3 Purchase & Billing Information
When you make a purchase, we collect:

items: Email address for order confirmation and eSIM delivery
Billing country (for tax and compliance purposes)
Phone number (optional, if provided at checkout)
Order details: plans purchased, quantities, prices, currency, and discount codes applied

content.text: Payment card details (card number, expiry, CVC) are collected and processed exclusively by our payment processor, Stripe. We never receive or store your full payment card information on our servers.
1.4 Usage Data
We automatically collect certain information when you use the Service:

items: Device information: model, operating system, screen size, and eSIM compatibility
App version and build number
Feature interactions and navigation patterns
IP address
General location data at country/region level (derived from IP address — we do not use GPS or precise location tracking)
Timestamp of actions (e.g. login, purchase, chat)

content.text: 1.5 Crash Reports & Performance Data

We use Sentry, a third-party error monitoring service, to collect crash reports and performance diagnostics in production. This data includes stack traces, device metadata, and app state at the time of the error. Personal identifiers (PII) are automatically scrubbed before transmission. Crash reporting is disabled in development environments.
1.6 Support & Chat Interactions
When you use the AI chat assistant or submit a support ticket, we collect:

items: The content of your chat messages and support requests
Feedback you provide on AI responses (thumbs up/down)
Support ticket subject, message body, and status updates

content.text: Chat messages are sent to third-party AI providers (OpenAI and/or Google Gemini) for response generation. We do not send your password, payment details, or other sensitive account data to AI providers. The following information is shared with AI providers to generate relevant, personalized responses: conversation text, your preferred language and currency, your first name, authentication status, and — when you request account-related assistance — data retrieved on your behalf such as order details, eSIM status, and referral information.
1.7 Referral Program Data

If you participate in our referral program, we collect and process your referral code, the number of successful referrals, and earned reward codes. This information is linked to your account email address.
1.8 On-Device Storage
The app stores certain data locally on your device for functionality and convenience:

items: Authentication tokens stored in secure device storage (iOS Keychain / Android Keystore)
App preferences (theme, language, currency) stored in local storage
Shopping cart contents stored locally
Favorite destinations stored locally and synced to our servers when you are logged in

content.text: This data remains on your device and is not transmitted to our servers unless required for functionality (e.g., syncing favorites to your account when logged in).
Under the GDPR, we process your personal data based on the following legal grounds:

items: Contract performance (Art. 6(1)(b)): Processing necessary to provide the Service, fulfill eSIM orders, manage your account, and process payments
Legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f)): Fraud prevention, security monitoring, service improvement, analytics, and customer support
Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)): Marketing communications (you can withdraw consent at any time), and where AI chat messages are processed by third-party providers
Legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)): Tax compliance, financial record-keeping, and responding to lawful requests from authorities

content.text: We use the collected information for the following purposes:

items: To provide, maintain, and improve the Service
To create and manage your user account
To process transactions, deliver eSIM profiles, and send order confirmations
To verify your email address during registration
To enable password reset and account recovery
To provide customer support through AI chat and human agents
To process and respond to support tickets
To operate the referral program and deliver earned rewards
To send transactional communications (welcome emails, order confirmations, receipts, ticket updates, referral rewards)
To send marketing emails (only with your explicit opt-in consent)
To detect, prevent, and address fraud, abuse, and security issues
To monitor application performance and fix errors (via Sentry)
To analyze usage trends and improve user experience
To comply with legal obligations and enforce our Terms of Service

content.text: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information. We share data with third parties only as necessary to provide the Service:

items: Airalo (eSIM provider): We share your email address and order details to provision and activate eSIM profiles. Airalo processes this data as a data processor on our behalf

Stripe (payment processor): Collects and processes your payment card details, billing email, and billing country. Stripe is PCI-DSS Level 1 certified. See Stripe's Privacy Policy at https://stripe.com/privacy

OpenAI and Google (AI providers): Chat conversation text, language preference, and currency are sent to generate AI responses. We do not send identifying personal data unless you include it in your messages. See OpenAI's Privacy Policy at https://openai.com/privacy and Google's Privacy Policy at https://policies.google.com/privacy
Sentry (error monitoring): Receives anonymized crash reports and performance data. PII is automatically scrubbed. See Sentry's Privacy Policy at https://sentry.io/privacy
Google, Facebook, Apple (social login providers): When you use social login, authentication data flows through these providers. We receive only name, email, and profile photo
Email delivery services: Transactional and marketing emails are sent through our email infrastructure
Legal authorities: We may disclose data when required by law, court order, or to protect our rights, safety, or property

content.text: We implement comprehensive security measures to protect your information:

items: All data in transit is encrypted using TLS (Transport Layer Security)
Passwords are hashed using industry-standard algorithms (bcrypt) — we never store plain-text passwords
Authentication tokens are stored in secure device storage (iOS Keychain / Android Keystore)
JWT-based authentication with automatic token rotation and expiration
API rate limiting and input sanitization to prevent abuse
Sensitive data fields are automatically scrubbed from error reports
Regular security audits and dependency vulnerability scanning

content.text: While we strive to protect your data, no method of electronic transmission or storage is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security but are committed to continuous improvement of our security practices.
We retain your personal information as follows:

items: Account data: Retained while your account is active. Deleted upon account deletion request, subject to legal retention obligations
Order and transaction records: Retained for a minimum of 7 years after the transaction date for tax and financial compliance purposes
Chat conversations: Retained for up to 12 months for service quality and support purposes
Support tickets: Retained for up to 24 months after resolution
Crash reports and performance data: Retained for up to 90 days
Marketing consent records: Retained for as long as the consent is valid, plus 3 years after withdrawal for compliance documentation

content.text: You may request deletion of your account and associated data at any time through the Profile Settings page in the app or by contacting support@simphonia.pt. Upon deletion, your data will be removed from active systems within 30 days, except where retention is required by law.
Under the GDPR and applicable data protection laws, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:

items: Right of access (Art. 15): Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you
Right to rectification (Art. 16): Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data. You can update your name directly in the app
Right to erasure / right to be forgotten (Art. 17): Request deletion of your data. You can delete your account directly through the app's Profile Settings
Right to restriction of processing (Art. 18): Request that we limit how we use your data while a concern is being resolved
Right to data portability (Art. 20): Request a machine-readable copy of the data you have provided to us
Right to object (Art. 21): Object to processing based on legitimate interests, including for direct marketing purposes

Right to withdraw consent (Art. 7): You may withdraw consent for marketing emails at any time through the app or the unsubscribe link. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing based on consent before its withdrawal

content.text: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at support@simphonia.pt. We will respond to your request within 30 days, as required by the GDPR.

content.html: If you believe your data protection rights have been violated, you have the right to lodge a complaint with your national supervisory authority. In Portugal, the supervisory authority is the Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados (CNPD) at www.cnpd.pt.

content.text: Our website uses minimal, essential cookies and local storage for functionality, including:

items: Theme preference (light/dark mode)
Language selection
Session management

content.text: We do not use third-party advertising or tracking cookies. The mobile app uses on-device storage (SharedPreferences and secure storage) for preferences and authentication tokens as described in Section 1.8.

The Service is not directed to children under 16 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 16. If we become aware that we have inadvertently collected data from a child under 16, we will take steps to delete that data as soon as possible. If you believe a child under 16 has provided us with personal data, please contact us at support@simphonia.pt.
Your personal data is primarily processed within the European Economic Area (EEA). However, some of our third-party service providers may process data outside the EEA:

items: Stripe (United States) — Payment processing, covered by Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) and Stripe's Data Processing Agreement
OpenAI (United States) — AI chat response generation, covered by SCCs and OpenAI's Data Processing Addendum
Google / Gemini (United States) — AI chat response generation and social login, covered by SCCs and Google's Data Processing Terms
Sentry (United States) — Error monitoring, covered by SCCs and Sentry's Data Processing Addendum
Airalo (varies) — eSIM provisioning and activation

content.text: Where data is transferred outside the EEA, we ensure appropriate safeguards are in place as required by Article 46 of the GDPR, including Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission.
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our data practices, the Service, or applicable law. We will notify you of material changes by:

items: Updating the "Last updated" date at the top of this page
Posting a notice on the website or in the app
Sending an email notification for significant changes (if you have an account)

content.text: We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically. Your continued use of the Service after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
The data controller responsible for your personal data is:

items: Simphonia
Lisbon, Portugal
Email: support@simphonia.pt

content.text: For any data protection inquiries, you may contact us at the email address above.
If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, wish to exercise your data protection rights, or have concerns about how we handle your data, contact us at:

items: Email: support@simphonia.pt
Website: https://simphonia.pt/support/
